description: This Java class implements the RoleReadPlatformService interface, providing database-driven retrieval of role data, including methods to get all roles, active roles, self-service roles, specific roles by ID, and roles associated with a given application user. It uses JDBC templates and maps SQL result sets to RoleData objects.

classes.name: RoleReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of role retrieval service using JDBC that fetches role data from database.

classes.name: RoleMapper
classes.description: RowMapper inner class that maps SQL result set rows to RoleData objects and provides schema definition for SQL queries.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all roles from the database, ordered by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllActiveRoles
methods.description: Fetches all active (not disabled) roles from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllSelfServiceRoles
methods.description: Fetches roles designated as self-service roles based on a predefined constant.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Fetches a single role by its ID; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveAppUserRoles
methods.description: Fetches roles associated with a specific application user ID.
